generic.description: Portable image-generation prompt; no provider-specific syntax assumed.
generation_guidance: Generate one complete flat academic design preview at the specified aspect ratio.
Favor a clear reader path and a small number of meaningful visual groups over decorative panels.
Show all mandatory scientific nodes and edges; if the composition is too dense, use a grouped overview with clearly indicated local expansion.
Text is critical: reproduce exact labels; do not improvise scientific content.
refinement_guidance: Apply only the requested local correction; retain composition and unrelated regions.
Do not regenerate new scientific nodes, formulas, axes, or empirical measurements.

gemini.description: Gemini-oriented structured brief. Heuristic adapter, not a certified model capability claim.
generation_guidance: Use the numbered scientific inventory, explicit reading path, and per-edge directives as binding design constraints.
Deliver a single wide, legible publication-oriented figure rather than multiple concept sketches on one canvas.
Use consistent visual vocabulary for modality encoding, label interactions, routing, and fusion; preserve the named objects exactly.
Minimize crossings by grouping related signals near their destinations; do not invent shortcut arrows.
refinement_guidance: Treat the supplied image as the composition to edit and the scientific contract as the source of truth.
Make the smallest visible local change that resolves the stated defect.

gpt-image.description: GPT Image-oriented explicit visual brief. Heuristic adapter, not a certified model capability claim.
generation_guidance: First establish the figure's dominant visual spine and region hierarchy, then render only the named semantic objects.
Enforce disciplined, print-legible academic typography and preserve label spelling and capitalization as literal text.
Make novelty and key data interactions visible through composition and contrast rather than excessive glow, icons, or shadows.
Prefer clean ports and short local connector routes; avoid crossing labels or unrelated modules.
refinement_guidance: Preserve all unaffected shapes, labels, arrow routes, colors, and relative positions in the reference.
Correct only the given region/defect; do not make global stylistic reinterpretations.
